rule: Boss death: checkdeath lowers the boss count; at zero with an enemy target it clears the room (every live enemy takes its remaining health as an ATK_BOSS_DEATH hit), sets level complete, and slows the game loop until the boss's fall routine runs, which turns the slow-motion off. Slow-motion steps the logic on one loop pass in three at default duration. Victory pose only for idle, grounded survivors when the boss was defeated. Boss music switches on spawn. A HUD panel draws name, state icon and health graph for entities with a popup. Mount crash drops the rider with the same attack.
keep: Slow-motion ends on the boss's landing, so the death beat has a visible end.
Clear-the-room as the level-end event on the last boss death.
Victory pose gated on idle, grounded survivors and a defeated boss.
HUD panel per boss: name, state icon (default, hurt, grabbed, dying), health graph.
Mount death drops the rider with the same fatal attack.
change: Slow-motion is client presentation only; the server records the death at the death tick.
Cleared minions go through the normal kill path flagged as cleared, so the ledger can choose to count or skip them.
Boss count is per zone, and the clear-out waits until every boss in the zone is down.
Comment in the donor says the rider does not take damage, but the code does call its takedamage; we follow the code and write our own comment.
look_test: Two clips of the existing boss at 375 wide: (1) instant death as today, (2) slow-motion until landing, one-second victory hold, minions cleared at the landing. Dom judges whether the landing reads as the end and whether the pose reads at phone size.
